BitBot XL library

bitbotXL.py lets you control the 4tronix BitBot XL with simple functions from a micro:bit MicroPython program.

  • Function reference
    • Movement
    • LEDs
    • Buzzer
    • Sensors

Getting started

  1. Upload both main.py (your program) and bitbotXL.py to the micro:bit.

  2. At the top of your program, import the library:

    from microbit import *
import bitbotXL as bot

  3. Call functions with the bot. prefix:

    bot.move_forward(50, 1000)   # forward at half speed for 1 second
print(bot.get_distance())
